says: Alice binds her checkout and registers its repository memory source. She records choice A (WAL with synchronous FULL), then choice B, which replaces A whole, and applies A's replacement by B; she then records choice C (exclusive locking) on the same question and withdraws it. A scoped search of that repository about the journal-mode concern, with history excluded, delivers only B, the winning unit; the same search with history included also delivers A marked superseded and C marked withdrawn, each at the revision that recorded it, over the same frontier and work scope. Resolving the same concern with superseded material excluded returns B current and C withdrawn — a withdrawal is an entry no filter drops — and with it included also returns A, superseded by B, over the same frontier. Each reader_result is held to C06/history_only_when_asked against the envelope it answers. What must not happen: a superseded or withdrawn unit delivered to the envelope that excluded history, the withdrawal dropped from current state so that A or C reads as current, an entry or unit returned without its standing, or the history run reading beyond the repository and the one memory source the envelope names.
